name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit values from a fixed offset in a base block into the buffer whose pointer is passed on the stack, skipping the copy when that pointer is null. It then calls the code address held in a second register and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:0:0000
name: run_guarded_setup_then_cleanup
description: Clears a flag byte, queries a structure through a table entry and, when one of its fields is zero, runs an initialization routine and stores its result in the flag. It then calls another routine and, if the flag is set, runs two follow-up routines before returning that routine's result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:0:006E
name: run_polling_counter_loop
description: Sets several global pointers and counters, then loops indefinitely: it advances a 64-bit counter, polls an input byte, compares it against a set of digit codes and a counter limit, and calls a series of routines and function pointers on each pass.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:13C94
name: claim_pool_slot
description: Checks a byte in a table at an index held in a register; if that entry is free and a fill counter is below a fixed limit, it stores the counter in the entry, records the index in a second table and advances the counter by four. Otherwise it returns the existing entry value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:13CAA
name: append_pool_entry_record
description: If a fill counter is below a fixed limit, writes the low byte of a register into a buffer at an offset, stores a long combining that offset and the counter in a table, and advances the counter by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:13CBC
name: record_pool_entry_and_bump
description: Writes a register value into a buffer at an offset, stores a long combining the offset and value into a table addressed through a pointer, and increments the word at that pointer by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:13D0E
name: partition_buckets_by_key
description: Clears a set of words, then repeatedly splits a table of 12-byte records into partitions by comparing a key against moving bounds and swapping entries around a boundary. Each pass selects the largest remaining partition and the routine finally writes the partition start offsets into an output table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:13F48
name: calculate_component_extrema
description: Initializes six word fields to minus one, then scans a block of 32-bit values, splitting each into three 4-bit components and tracking the minimum and maximum of each. It stores the three spans and their sum into the structure.
